Build a stylized elven courtyard in a rocky, wooded valley under soft daylight. A circular stone plaza forms the center, with two round elven homes on opposite sides of the plaza. Give the homes domed roofs, ornamental roof details, and arched entrances. Place a stone altar at the center of the plaza, with a cluster of blue crystals on top. A broad stone stair leads up to the front of the plaza, and an ornamental arch frames the stair entrance. Add railings along the outer edges of the plaza and beside the stair, leaving the approach open. Arrange benches around the plaza and lanterns beside the approach. Behind the homes, group large trees and irregular rocks to enclose the courtyard. Scatter smaller rocks, grass, flowers, and mushrooms around the bases of the trees. Add ivy to selected building walls. Keep the route from the stair to the altar clear, and use pale stone architecture surrounded by lush green vegetation.
